moves.name: Dark Wish
moves.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Dark Zone. (A Dark Zone powers up Dark-type attacks.)

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: Has a chance (20%) of making the target flinch.

moves.name: Perpetual Nightmare!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Sp. Atk by 2 stat ranks. Raises the user’s accuracy and critical-hit rate by 1 stat rank.

moves.name: Perfect World Dark Pulse
moves.description: This attack’s power increases when the zone is a Dark Zone.

passives.name: Dark, Slumbering World
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 when it uses Dark Wish. Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs when attacking a target that is asleep. Lowers one of the following stats of all opposing sync pairs by one stat rank at random when the user’s Pokémon uses a status move: Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, or evasiveness.
